title: float() on the raw Challenge header age string will crash the run rather than record a mismatch
evidence_20260911: Not reproducible. Scope of this check: the 47 headers in work/external_lineage_sources_20260910/ptbxl/challenge. The remaining Challenge PTB-XL headers were not downloaded, so a non-numeric, non-NaN value elsewhere is unchecked rather than excluded.
